detail.longDescription: As promised, the changelogs for Cork 2.0.0 are out, and they're the longest, by far, of any of the previous changelogs Blog: https:// blog.corkmac.app/p/cork-200-is -out-everything-changed Forum: https:// forum.rikidar.eu/topic/3/cork- 2.0.0-is-out-everything-is-improved Have fun :) If you'd like to help Cork and its community grow, consider posting about it on other platforms.
